description: Read stored upcoming earnings and ex-dividend dates, plus recent equity listings. Supports ticker/company search and explicit effective windows, market-cap filters, native listing quote currencies, available source metadata and partial coverage. Recent first-trade dates are not confirmed IPOs or an upcoming IPO schedule. Calendar dates and estimates can change; missing events mean unknown coverage, never proof that no event exists. Read-only; at most three calendar requests, plus a ticker lookup when q carries a Yahoo exchange suffix. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

days.description: Forward days for earnings and ex-dividend, inclusive of the API server's current date. A nonblank q makes the backend use 120 days regardless of this value.

include.description: Selected stored calendars: upcoming earnings, upcoming ex-dividend dates, and recent listings (not an upcoming IPO schedule).

limit.description: Maximum rows per selected calendar, not an overall result count. A full page may omit other matching events.

listingMonths.description: Trailing months for recent listings. A nonblank q makes the backend search 60 months regardless of this value.

minCapUsd.description: Optional minimum market capitalization in USD. Omit to retain API defaults: 50 million for earnings/ex-dividend and zero for listings. Listings with unknown market cap are retained even with a positive floor.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive ticker or company-name contains search, also matched with spaces removed. This is not an exact ticker filter. A Yahoo-style symbol whose listing Bullrun stores in another form (BMW.DE as BMW, 7203.T as 7203) is searched under the stored ticker. A nonblank search widens earnings/ex-dividend to 120 days and listings to 60 months. % and _ act as search wildcards.

name: get_corporate_calendar
title: Get corporate calendar
